finding: Byte-complete retention and SHA-256 agreement do not prove that each retained payload is semantically the artifact role named by the manifest; a validly hashed payload can be substituted into the wrong role or contain a hidden cross-commit claim.
design_implication: Require semantic binding after byte verification and before promotion: parse every JSON role, validate its minimum role shape, require internal exact-commit claims, reject any nested cross-commit claim, and independently validate the retained gh command contains gh api, --paginate, --slurp, and the target commit.

verification.environment: isolated Node runtime using the exact source and test text before publication
cases: JSON payload without internal commit claim rejected

uncertainty: Role-shape predicates are deliberately minimal and have not yet been validated against a real authenticated retained evidence set; integration may expose schema aliases that require explicit, tested adapters rather than permissive fallback.
falsification_route: Run the verifier on a real seven-role exact-commit retention set, then substitute each role with another validly hashed role, add a nested conflicting head_sha, and remove each required gh command token in turn; every mutation must fail closed.
privacy_boundary: No credentials, private workflow payloads, deployment secrets, or user source material are included.
